name: Boon of the Night Spirit
summary: An epic boon granting Invisibility and Resistance while in Dim Light or Darkness.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.text: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

benefits.name: Merge with Shadows
benefits.text: While within {ref:glossary/dim-light} or {ref:glossary/darkness}, you can give yourself the {ref:condition/invisible} condition as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a {ref:glossary/reaction}.

benefits.name: Shadowy Form
benefits.text: While within {ref:glossary/dim-light} or {ref:glossary/darkness}, you have {ref:glossary/resistance} to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.
